paragraphs: Bar Hedya, before Rav Achai (see his entry). He wished to bring a bill of divorce before Rabbi Achi: Gittin 5b. In Chullin 106b he said, “I was standing before Rabbi Ammi the priest.” He saw women washing linen garments in Tiberias during the intermediate festival days, and Abaye objected to his words: Moed Katan 18, beginning of side b. In Sukkah 43b: “When Bar Hedya came …; Ravin came ….”
